# Design

Architecture decision records (ADRs), designs, contracts and plans. ADRs live
here beside their designs, one file each, named `ADR-NNN-title.md` (Developer
Handbook §22.3).

## ADR register

ADRs come first in the list below. The status in brackets is the ADR's own
status line; the [current status](../STATUS.md) wins where they disagree about
what is implemented today.
